message.content: Security and data minimisation are crucial aspects to consider when deploying AI systems. AI can introduce new security risks and make managing them more challenging. The data minimisation principle aims to reduce the amount of personal data processed, thereby enhancing privacy and security. Techniques for both data minimisation and effective AI development and deployment are presented. This section is aimed at technical professionals associated with security and data minimisation in AI. It explains how AI systems can exacerbate known security risks and presents the challenges for compliance with the data minimisation principle. The section also discusses privacy attacks, steps to manage these risks, and available data minimisation and privacy-preserving techniques for AI systems.
